Noble Victories

Released November 16, 2011 · 102 cards

Expanded

Noble Victories is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Black & White series, released in English on November 16, 2011. Its main set has 101 cards, plus 1 secret rare numbered beyond the set (102 in total). It includes 94 Pokémon, 8 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

21 illustrators worked on Noble Victories. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (15), Kagemaru Himeno (10), Kouki Saitou (8), Masakazu Fukuda (8), Naoki Saito (7), Shin Nagasawa (7), match (6), Atsuko Nishida (5).
